mentions.name: Post-quantum long-term file encryption tool
mentions.description: An encryption tool designed for encrypting and archiving long-term highly confidential files in the post-quantum era, intended to be released as open source after a period of dogfooding. The author plans to use it to encrypt and back up GPG keys offline, burn them onto M-DISC discs, and store them in a bank safe.
mentions.problem: Securely preserving highly confidential files over the long term against decryption threats in the post-quantum era.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am currently developing a great encryption tool for long-term highly confidential files in the post quantum era, but I am still concerned about any issues with it, so I am personally using it for a period of time to prove that this tool can be released as open source!
mentions.author: LamGC
